hero.title: Lake Ohrid on your doorstep
hero.subtitle: Two calm, fully equipped apartments in the centre of Pogradec—minutes from the water, with the comfort of a longer stay in mind.

guesthouseInfo.locationDetails: Two carefully decorated apartments in the heart of Pogradec, in a quiet area close to shops, markets, and the Orthodox church. They're about a five-minute walk apart—handy for friends or families who want to be near each other while still having their own privacy. Lake Ohrid is only two to three minutes on foot: for walks, a quick dip, or simply a coffee with a memorable view. The town centre, the beach, and the bus station aren't far at all. Whether you come for a few nights or stay for weeks or up to three months, from day one you'll feel welcome and at home.
guesthouseInfo.facilitiesDetails: Each apartment is designed so you can live comfortably for as long as you stay: a fully fitted kitchen, air conditioning throughout, a TV, stable Wi-Fi, and a bathroom with a washing machine. You'll also have fresh towels, a balcony with a striking view, and windows that fill the space with light—the place stays airy and calm.
guesthouseInfo.preferedVisitorsTitle: Who finds their place with us?
guesthouseInfo.preferedVisitorsDetails: Prima Apartments is the ideal setting for couples, families, solo travellers, and groups of friends. Some guests choose us for a short break; others stay longer—weeks or months—to really relax by the lake and get to know Pogradec at its characteristically peaceful pace. Even when the cooler seasons arrive, the light indoors and the comfort inside make for a pleasant stay whenever you want a break from everyday routine.

houseRules.panelRulesHint: Good to know before you arrive
houseRules.ruleReservations: From 2 nights up to about 3 months. Ask us about better rates for stays of 6+ nights.
houseRules.rule1: Check-in and check-out are contactless. Check-in and check-out times are flexible.
houseRules.rule2: Smoking inside the apartments is strictly forbidden. Smoking is allowed on the balcony only.
houseRules.rule3: Payment by bank transfer (BKT), PayPal, or cash.
